text:
You can cancel or change an order for free within **2 hours** of placing it, from "My Orders" on the website or app. After that, the order is in the packing queue and can't be changed online, but support can try to intercept it before it ships, though that isn't guaranteed. Once an order has shipped, it can't be cancelled.

If your order is past the 2-hour window, send me the order number (format LF- plus six digits) and I can help escalate it to a Support Lead to try to intercept it.
